decisions.reason: A multi-model minimum quantity lubrication line close to the core offer represents substantial invested engineering and public commitment, and the missing website evidence after 2019 can be attributed to archiving gaps and pandemic-related demand dips rather than failure.

The hydrocyclone filter extends the firm's core coolant filtration platform and its announced modular one-stop strategy, so management would persist and attribute any weak results to the temporary 2020-2021 machine-tool downturn.

The gravity band filter sits squarely in the established filtration portfolio with modular reuse and spare-parts service ties, making abandonment costly to justify given the prior investment and visible launch.
